serving_overhead.assumption: Traced GPU kernel durations are representative of normal execution. The measurements come from separate runs; this is not an independently measured gap total.

correctness_scope: Current repaired release: **320 forced decode tokens after a fresh 60,000-token Pi prefill**, plus the prefill prediction, in each of four arms. Compiled M1 versus compiled M8, eager M1 versus compiled M1, eager M8 versus compiled M8, and eager M1 versus compiled M8 each produced the results below. Compiled controls use production piecewise graphs; eager controls include the existing RoPE rounding repair. The **full BF16 comparison head** exposes target-body differences; production uses approximate Global-512, measured separately. [Run identities and all four comparisons](benchmarks/results/current-320-confirmations-20260924.json).
correctness_limits: Each comparison also matched all 320 full-vocabulary logit hashes and the prefill prediction. This is finite execution consistency, not independent model certification, an arbitrary-input proof or a natural-completion quality test. This fresh slice comes from the retained Pi corpus; it is not the deleted historical standalone 320-token fixture. The earlier 10K study remains historical and was not rerun.
timing_scope: Latest retained **compiled, piecewise-graph** decode profile from a saved **60,000-input-token Pi prefix**, with the global-256 head, both alignment repairs and the GGZ14-derived backports. The trace contains **8 observed profile rounds**; the displayed stage and layer values are arithmetic means over **6 complete retained rounds** (rounds 0–4 and 6), with one sample per stage per round. Each sample is one compiled decode/profile cycle containing drafting and target verification. This is a kernel profile, not six natural completions or a 60K-output run; the trace has no natural-completion output-token total. Round 5 lacks a complete kernel inventory; round 7 has no following target start to close its interval. Selection uses inventory and observed boundaries, never duration. Work preceding the first target is excluded. The subsequent tiled-activation change is prefill-only and does not change these decode kernels. Each fused kernel has one combined duration.

Drafter.change: Defer INT2 draft-head packing until the real shared target weights are bound, avoiding uninitialized placeholder weights.

Embedding + first input normalization +.change: Preserve the M1 reduction and BF16/FP8 rounding at every admitted prefill width, removing batch-dependent activation differences.

Layer input residual/normalization + FP8.change: Preserve the M1 reduction and BF16/FP8 rounding at every admitted prefill width, removing batch-dependent activation differences.

GDN input projection.change: Preserve stored MXFP4 coefficients in the folded lookup and repair fragment/tiled per-block fallbacks while retaining the qualified GEMM dispatch.

GDN layout/copies and buffer initializat.change: Reject unsupported packed GDN inner strides and overlapping state slots; retain the existing nine-slot layout.

GDN convolution.change: Aligned GDN convolution product and accumulation arithmetic across M1/M8 and eager/compiled execution.

GDN recurrence and gates.change: Use stable log1p(exp(x)) in M1, M8 and prefill so small nonzero recurrent gates survive FP32 cancellation.

GDN output gated normalization + FP8 pro.change: Preserve the M1 gated-normalization reduction layout during prefill and retain one final BF16 rounding before FP8 production.

GDN output projection.change: Preserve stored MXFP4 coefficients in the folded lookup and repair fragment/tiled per-block fallbacks while retaining the qualified GEMM dispatch.

Attention input projection.change: Preserve stored MXFP4 coefficients in the folded lookup and repair fragment/tiled per-block fallbacks while retaining the qualified GEMM dispatch.

Attention Q/K normalization, RoPE and la.change: Added live-row handling for compiled M8 graph padding while retaining the repaired RoPE arithmetic.

Attention KV write.change: Aligned causal attention and cache writes with the M1/M8 arithmetic contract.

Attention decode.change: Preserve BF16 query/key/value range, scale after the FP32 dot product, retain probability residuals and reject incompatible FP8 formats; keep the page-boundary traversal repair.

Attention split-KV merge.change: Keep split outputs and normalization sums in FP32 until the final BF16 merge, removing intermediate FP16 rounding loss.

Attention output gating.change: Preserved attention output gating and intermediate BF16 rounding in aligned M1/M8 execution.

Attention output activation FP8 quantiza.change: Enabled qualified native-rounding FP8 output production and rejected approximate traced quantization.

Attention output projection.change: Preserve stored MXFP4 coefficients in the folded lookup and repair fragment/tiled per-block fallbacks while retaining the qualified GEMM dispatch.

Post-attention/GDN residual/normalizatio.change: Preserve the M1 reduction and BF16/FP8 rounding at every admitted prefill width, removing batch-dependent activation differences.

MLP gate/up projection.change: Preserve stored MXFP4 coefficients in the folded lookup and repair fragment/tiled per-block fallbacks while retaining the qualified GEMM dispatch.

MLP SiLU and gating.change: Preserved intermediate BF16 rounding in aligned M1/M8 and eager/compiled arithmetic; the slower fused SiLU remains disabled.

MLP down input FP8 quantization.change: Enabled qualified native per-token FP8 production for the down projection input.

MLP down projection.change: Preserve stored MXFP4 coefficients in the folded lookup and repair fragment/tiled per-block fallbacks while retaining the qualified GEMM dispatch.

Final normalization/layout.change: Aligned final normalization and full BF16 head precision boundaries while preserving the rounding contract.

Global-256 target head.change: Removed the eight-per-tile target capacity limit with global INT2 top-256 selection and BF16 reranking; selection remains approximate.

Other GPU bookkeeping.change: Integrated qualified sampling, cache/state bookkeeping and graph-capture admission; no isolated correctness claim is made for this aggregate row.

round_timing.boundary: First target GPU kernel to the first target GPU kernel of the next round.
round_timing.scope: Profiled GPU cycle; gaps include launch/host/wait and possible profiler overhead. Individual causes are not attributed. Excludes request admission, prefill and Pi/transport latency.

observer_effect.reason: The preserved slow window included first-use Triton compilation for speculative decode shapes; its wall time is not a steady-state production measurement.

stage_profile_2k.scope: Dedicated compiled Global-256 target-head diagnostic profile with the repaired stock GDN path. Each synthetic context ran 2,000 forced output positions; the displayed named-stage values are means over the retained compiled M8 cycles after the warm-up window. The 0K, 60K and 200K contexts are shown in that order. Stage 26 is a separate benchmark: it must use a matching uninstrumented full-round control and subtract the sum of the 25 named instrumented stages. It is never computed from the instrumented profile wall time. Profile timing is diagnostic and not production throughput. Profile coverage was complete at all three contexts; the 0K pass retained timing evidence but its harness cross-pass final-logit hash check was non-qualifying, so this table makes no correctness claim.

stage_notes.drafter: Produces the speculative proposal rows before target verification.
stage_notes.embedding: Looks up the embedding for each forced target position.
stage_notes.input_preparation: Prepares model inputs and cache metadata around the target call.
stage_notes.input_norm_residual: Applies layer-input residual and normalization work.
stage_notes.gdn_other: GDN parent-scope work not emitted as a separate child stage by the profiler.
stage_notes.gdn_convolution: Updates the rolling causal convolution state.
stage_notes.gdn_recurrence_gates_state: Runs the recurrent GDN update, gates and state writes.
stage_notes.gdn_output_norm: Normalizes and gates the GDN output.
stage_notes.gdn_output_projection: Projects GDN output back into the residual stream.
stage_notes.attention_qkv_projection: Projects hidden rows to attention Q/K/V inputs.
stage_notes.rope: Applies rotary position encoding and attention layout work.
stage_notes.kv_cache_and_attention: Writes/reads KV state and runs the context-dependent attention kernel.
stage_notes.attention_gating_and_other: Attention residual gating and other attention-module work.
stage_notes.attention_output_projection: Projects the attention output into the residual stream.
stage_notes.post_attention_norm_residual: Applies post-attention/GDN residual and normalization work.
stage_notes.mlp_activation: Runs the MLP activation and gating.
stage_notes.target_sampling: Runs target sampling and acceptance bookkeeping.
stage_notes.target_other: Other target-side kernels outside the named head.
stage_notes.forced_replay_control: Controls the forced replay used by the diagnostic harness.
stage_notes.layer_other: Layer kernels not assigned to a more specific stage.

stage26.label: Uninstrumented-round residual
stage26.definition: separate unprofiled full-round mean minus the sum of the 25 named instrumented-stage means; the two runs share build, mode, fixture and forced-replay schedule but retain independent measurement windows

evidence_sources.embedding: Embedding + first input normalization + FP8 production
evidence_sources.gdn_output_norm: GDN output gated normalization + FP8 production
evidence_sources.attention_qk_norm: Attention Q/K normalization, RoPE and layout
evidence_sources.rope: Attention Q/K normalization, RoPE and layout

stage26_benchmark.definition: Historical control minus stage sums; rejected as a production-gap measurement by the timing audit. Matching configuration labels do not establish matched schedules, boundaries or observer-free stage durations.
